title: OpenAI DevDay Exchange 2026
text:
Apply to attend
EN

OpenAI DevDay Exchange brings together developers and technical founders from around the world for hands-on building and conversations about how leading teams are shaping the next generation of AI products. Each event is shaped by its city - creating a space to exchange ideas, share what they’re building, learn from one another, and connect directly with OpenAI teams.

What to expect:

Technical sessions with OpenAI product and engineering teams
Real-world projects and Codex workflows from top founders and developers
Hands-on guidance for your projects
Open conversations with the OpenAI team and leading builders
Apply to join OpenAI DevDay Exchange in a city near you.

Bengaluru - October 16
Tokyo - October 20
Seoul - October 22
Berlin - October 26
Paris - October 28
London - November 3
São Paulo - November 6
Mexico City - November 10

Applications are currently being reviewed, but please still feel free to apply.

The event begins at 2pm local time. The venue details and full program will be shared following application approval.
